applicant.name: Dr. Sabine Kofler
applicant.organisation: Digital Health Lab, medical university (research group)

purpose: We train and validate a model that predicts readmission within 30 days after a hospital stay for heart failure. The model learns from the sequence of diagnoses, prescriptions, laboratory values and stays of each individual patient over time, so aggregated statistics are not enough; individual-level histories are required. We will only export model weights and performance metrics.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications, kidney function values and encounters for adults with at least one inpatient stay for heart failure.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure stay = inpatient stay whose main diagnosis (primary_icd10) starts with I50, started from 2023 to 2025.
Cohort = adults with at least one heart failure stay.
Records: conditions, medications, eGFR observations (LOINC 62238-1) and encounters.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
